The '''Dorsis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorsis]].
